title: Server Files
empty_dir_hint: Upload files by dragging them into the list, or create files and folders from the toolbar.
list_truncated: The listing was truncated at the server's safety limit.
stopped_required_body: File access is available while the server is running or fully stopped. Wait for startup or shutdown to finish.
live_warning: While the server is running, changes to world files may be overwritten by the server. Plugin and configuration changes usually take effect after a restart.
live_world_confirm: I acknowledge the risk of modifying world directories while the server is running.
live_world_confirm_required: Select the confirmation checkbox before modifying world directories or extracting an archive while the server is running.
not_yours_body: Only the owner or an admin can edit this server's files.
binary_hint: Binary files do not support text editing. Download the file, process it with compatible software, and upload it again. Text editing may corrupt the file.
conflict_body: The file was modified by another administrator or server process after it was opened. The current edits have not been written. Load the latest content or overwrite the existing file.
conflict_reload_hint: Discard current edits and load the latest file content
conflict_overwrite_hint: Overwrite the existing file with the current edits
status_refresh_failed: Server status refresh failed. The displayed state may be outdated: {{reason}}
upload_hint: Select files or folders to upload into the current directory, or drag them into the list.
managed_no_rename: This entry is managed by Felis. Its name and location must remain unchanged.
wait_for_uploads: This operation is unavailable until uploads complete.
name_dots: “.” and “..” cannot be used as names.
name_too_long: The name exceeds the length limit.
name_taken: A file or folder with this name already exists in the current directory.
delete_file_body: The file will be permanently deleted. Back up any required content before deletion.
delete_folder_body: The folder and all its contents will be permanently deleted. Back up any required content before deletion.
secret_config_unreadable: config/paper-global.yml contains the shared proxy forwarding secret and cannot be read or edited online.
upload_exists: A file with this name already exists in the current directory.
upload_folder_there: A folder with this name already exists in the current directory.
upload_name_too_long: The filename exceeds 255 bytes. Shorten the filename and upload the file again.
upload_no_room: The world volume has {{free}} available, which is insufficient for a {{size}} file. Free storage space and retry.
wait_for_op: Files cannot be modified until the background operation completes.
wait_for_download: This operation is unavailable until download preparation completes.
wait_for_backup: World backup is in progress. File changes are available after completion.
wait_for_restore: World restoration is in progress. File changes are available after completion.
wait_for_world_export: World export is in progress. File changes are available after the download ends.
wait_for_file_download: A file download is reading world data. File changes are available after the transfer completes.
unzip_conflicts_body: Some archive entries conflict with files in the current directory. Confirmation overwrites conflicting files and extracts the remaining entries. Back up any required original files before proceeding.
download_started_props: Download started for {{filename}}. The rcon.password value is redacted in the downloaded content.
download_started_config: Download started for {{filename}}. paper-global.yml, which contains the shared proxy forwarding secret, is excluded.
download_out_of_memory: The packaging task terminated because its file list exceeded available memory. The download did not start. Split the content into smaller folders and download them separately.
download_busy: File download limits have been reached: two concurrent requests per account, four across the platform, and thirty per account per hour. Retry after existing tasks complete or rate limits reset.
secret_config_no_download: config/paper-global.yml contains the shared proxy forwarding secret and cannot be downloaded.
ops_refresh_failed: Could not read the background operations: {{reason}}
op_upload_exists: A file with this name already exists. The upload did not replace it. Select Replace when uploading again.
op_unzip_conflicts_one: Extraction would overwrite {{count}} existing file. The operation has not been performed.
op_unzip_conflicts_other: Extraction would overwrite {{count}} existing files. The operation has not been performed.
op_volume_full: Insufficient world volume space: {{need}} required, {{avail}} available. This operation did not modify files.
archive_invalid: The archive is damaged or is not a supported ZIP, TAR, TAR.GZ or TGZ archive. This operation did not modify files.
archive_invalid_entry: The size or checksum of archive entry {{entry}} does not match. This operation did not modify files.
archive_unsafe: Archive entry {{entry}} contains an out-of-directory path or a device file. The entire archive was rejected without extraction.
archive_symlink: Archive entry {{entry}} is a symbolic or hard link. The entire archive was rejected without extraction.
type_conflict: Entry {{entry}} conflicts with an existing entry of the same name because one is a file and the other is a folder. Rename or delete the existing {{entry}} before extraction.
job_failed: The background task ended without a failure reason. Refresh the file list to verify the result before retrying.
job_timed_out: The background task exceeded its two-hour execution limit and was terminated. Refresh the file list to verify the result before retrying.
job_out_of_memory: The background task terminated due to insufficient memory. Verify server files and task resources before retrying.
job_out_of_memory_unzip: The extraction task terminated due to insufficient memory. Verify server files, then split the content into smaller archives before retrying.
preview_large_hint: The editor reads files up to {{limit}}. Download it to edit, then upload your changes.
url_hint: Only public HTTP or HTTPS URLs are supported.
target_path_hint: The path is relative to the server file root and includes the filename.
search_truncated: Search shows at most 500 results, searches within 16 levels of subdirectories and skips region, entities and poi chunk directories.
copied_selection: {{count}} entries selected for copying. Open the destination folder and select Paste.
cut_selection: {{count}} entries selected for moving. Open the destination folder and select Paste.
batch_delete_body: Selected files and folder contents will be permanently deleted in sequence. Entries deleted before a failure will not be restored.
image_invalid: The file does not contain a supported PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP image.
rollback_incomplete: The operation could not be fully rolled back. Verify server files and preserved content before retrying. Protected files may require an administrator to recover them.
op_task_conflicts_one: The operation would overwrite {{count}} existing file. No files have been changed.
op_task_conflicts_other: The operation would overwrite {{count}} existing files. No files have been changed.
task_conflicts_body: The destination contains files with matching names. Confirmation retries the operation and overwrites conflicting files. Back up any content that must be retained.
task_retry_unavailable: The source parameters are no longer available on this page. Select the entries and start the operation again.
selection_limit: Select at most 500 entries per operation.
properties_form_hint: Only edited properties are changed. Comments and unlisted properties are retained. Missing values remain unset until edited. Configuration changes usually take effect after a server restart.
properties_parse_error: The file contains an invalid Unicode escape. Switch to Text to correct it before using the form.
properties_invalid_enum: Select one of the listed values.
properties_managed_platform: Felis manages this value and writes it at server startup. It is read-only in the form.
properties_managed_login: Felis manages this value for the login server and writes it at startup. It is read-only in the form.
properties_hint_gamemode: Sets the game mode for new players.
properties_hint_force_gamemode: Applies the default game mode whenever a player joins.
properties_hint_hardcore: Locks the difficulty to hard and makes players spectators after death.
properties_hint_allow_flight: Disables flight checks for players using flight modifications.
properties_hint_max_players: Sets the maximum number of concurrent players.
properties_hint_white_list: Restricts joining to players on the allowlist.
properties_hint_enforce_whitelist: Disconnects players removed from the allowlist when it is reloaded.
properties_hint_player_idle_timeout: Disconnects idle players after this many minutes. Set 0 to disable the timeout.
properties_hint_op_permission_level: Sets the default permission level assigned by the op command, from 0 to 4.
properties_hint_level_name: Names the directory used for the world. Changing this value selects a different world after restart.
properties_hint_level_seed: Sets the seed used when generating a new world. Existing world terrain is retained.
properties_hint_level_type: Sets the world generation preset, for example minecraft:normal. Availability depends on the server version and data packs.
properties_hint_generate_structures: Allows structures such as villages to generate in new terrain.
properties_hint_motd: Sets the description displayed in the multiplayer server list. Line breaks are stored as properties escapes.
properties_hint_enable_status: Allows the server to respond to status requests from the multiplayer server list.
properties_hint_log_ips: Includes player IP addresses in server logs.
properties_hint_server_port: Port used by the game server inside its container.
properties_hint_online_mode: Authentication for public connections is handled by the Felis proxy.
properties_hint_enable_rcon: Enables the internal remote console used by Felis.
properties_hint_rcon_port: Port used for the internal remote console.
properties_hint_rcon_password: The value is hidden. Saving the placeholder retains the current password.
properties_hint_bungeecord: Controls legacy BungeeCord forwarding for the login server.
properties_hint_bungee_guard: Controls BungeeGuard forwarding for the login server.
properties_hint_velocity_modern: Controls modern Velocity forwarding for the login server.
properties_hint_forwarding_secrets: The value is hidden. Saving the placeholder retains the current forwarding secret.
properties_hint_view_distance: Sets the distance of world data sent to players, from 3 to 32 chunks.
properties_hint_simulation_distance: Sets the distance in which entities are updated, from 3 to 32 chunks.
properties_hint_entity_broadcast_range_p: Scales entity tracking distances, from 10% to 1000%.
properties_hint_use_native_transport: Allows native network transport optimizations on supported platforms.
properties_invalid_sha1: Enter 40 hexadecimal characters or leave the value empty.
properties_invalid_uuid: Enter a UUID in 8-4-4-4-12 hexadecimal format or leave the value empty.
properties_hint_function_permission_leve: Sets the permission level for data pack functions, from 1 to 4.
properties_hint_hide_online_players: Omits player names from the server list status response.
properties_hint_enforce_secure_profile: Requires joining players to have a public key signed by Mojang.
properties_hint_spawn_protection: Protects a square around the world spawn with side length 2 × radius + 1. Set 0 to disable. Requires at least one operator.
properties_hint_max_world_size: Limits the world radius during initial world creation, from 1 to 29999984 blocks. This does not change the current world border.
properties_hint_broadcast_console_to_ops: Sends console command output to online operators.
properties_hint_broadcast_rcon_to_ops: Sends RCON command output to online operators.
properties_hint_network_compression_thre: Compresses packets at or above this size. Any negative value disables compression.
properties_hint_rate_limit: Sets the packet rate above which players are disconnected. Set 0 to disable the limit.
properties_hint_resource_pack: Sets the resource pack download URL sent to players. Leave empty to send no pack.
properties_hint_require_resource_pack: Disconnects players who decline or cannot load the configured resource pack.
properties_hint_resource_pack_sha1: Sets the pack verification hash as 40 hexadecimal characters. The value may be empty.
properties_hint_resource_pack_id: Identifies the resource pack with a UUID. The value may be empty.
properties_hint_resource_pack_prompt: Sets the download prompt using the text component syntax supported by the server version. The value may be empty.
properties_hint_pvp: Applies through 1.21.8. From 1.21.9, use the pvp game rule; from 1.21.11 its ID is minecraft:pvp. Shown only when this property exists.
properties_hint_enable_command_block: Applies through 1.21.8. In 1.21.9–1.21.10, use commandBlocksEnabled; from 1.21.11, use minecraft:command_blocks_work. Shown only when this property exists.
properties_hint_allow_nether: Applies through 1.21.8. In 1.21.9–1.21.10, use allowEnteringNetherUsingPortals; from 1.21.11, use minecraft:allow_entering_nether_using_portals. Shown only when this property exists.
properties_hint_spawn_monsters: Applies through 1.21.8. In 1.21.9–1.21.10, use spawnMonsters; from 1.21.11, use minecraft:spawn_monsters. Shown only when this property exists.
properties_hint_spawn_animals: Applies through 1.21.1 and was removed in 1.21.2 without a direct equivalent game rule. Shown only when this property exists.
properties_hint_spawn_npcs: Applies through 1.21.1 and was removed in 1.21.2 without a direct equivalent game rule. Shown only when this property exists.
